{{Quote|Black Sword Command defended the center of the Empire's Rim territories. Praxlis, Corridan, the entire Kokash and Farlax sectors.|[[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]]|<ref name="BtS" />}}
The '''Praxlis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Praxlis system/Legends|Praxlis system]].

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Praxlis sector was located at the center of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rim territories and was defended by the [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]].<ref name="BtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Praxlis was referred in only one line in ''[[Before the Storm]]'': "''Black Sword Command defended the center of the Empire's Rim territories. Praxlis, Corridan, the entire Kokash and Farlax sectors.''" and let the nature of Praxlis and Corridan ambiguous. Praxlis and Corridan were interpreted as planets in the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' but they were eventually stated as sectors in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
